verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence is the Audio Overview 'Debate' format, which is documented for exploring multiple perspectives across sources. Chat answers carry in-line citations that can be hovered or opened in context, and users can choose which sources the model uses, so an analyst can manually trace and compare where claims come from. Missing for 10: any documented chat or report feature that explicitly flags agreement or contradiction between sources, a disagreement view in text outputs rather than only audio, and hands-on or independent corroboration that conflicts are surfaced instead of blended into one answer.
